ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka nang stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de

ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol

tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs

so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i sngon gyi

mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka dbang po rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka stobs rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag gi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam gyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa rgya che ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi sngon gyi

mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshad myed pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshad myed pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa rgya che

ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka mi 'jigs pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mi 'jigs pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka snying

rje chen po rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po

rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs tshad myed do/ /gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba tshad myed do/ /tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du shes tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du shes kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du shes kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'du shes tshad myed do/ /'du shes tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du byed kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir

'du byed tshad myed do/ /'du byed tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myig tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myig tshad myed do/ /myig tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba tshad myed do/ /rna ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i tshad

ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ sna tshad myed do/ /sna tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lce tshad myed do/ /lce tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ lus tshad myed do/ /lus tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ yid tshad myed do/ /yid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'

sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs tshad myed do/ /gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sgra tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sgra'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sgra'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ sgra tshad myed do/ /sgra tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dri tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dri'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dri'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dri tshad myed do/ /dri tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ro tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ro'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ro'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ ro tshad myed do/ /ro tshad myed pa'i phyir/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka reg tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg gi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du reg gi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ reg tshad myed do/ /reg tshad myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chos tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chos kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ chos tshad myed do/ /chos tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes

pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs

su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i 'dus te

reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa

su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis

tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed de/ kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bzhi pa/ /kau shi ka sa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di tshad med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sa'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sa'i khams tshad myed do/ /sa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chu'i

khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chu'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ chu'i khams tshad myed do/ /chu'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mye'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mye'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du me'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mye'i khams tshad myed do/ /mye'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rlung gi khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rlung gi khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rlung gi khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rlung gi khams tshad myed do/ /rlung gi khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka nam mkha'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper

na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du nam mkha'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'i khams tshad myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ma rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ma rig pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ma rig pa'i chos kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa tshad myed do/ /ma rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du byed kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'du

byed tshad myed do/ /'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mying dang gzugs tshad med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mying dang gzugs kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mying dang gzugs tshad myed do/ /mying dang gzugs tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka skye mched drug tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug gi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du skye mched drug gi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ skye mched drug tshad myed do/ /skye mched drug tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen

po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ reg pa tshad myed do/ /reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba tshad myed do/ /tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sred pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sred pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sred pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ /sred pa tshad myed do/ /sred pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka len pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar len pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du len pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ len pa

tshad myed do/ /len pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka srid pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar srid pa'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du srid pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ srid pa tshad myed do/ /srid pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka skye ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du skye ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ skye ba tshad myed do/ /skye ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rga shi tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rga shi'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rga shi'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rga shi tshad myed do/ /rga shi tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i

tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste

dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di

lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du phyi stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad med do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/

stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid tshad med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chen po stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ chen po stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ kau shi ka de bzhin du don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin

pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ thog ma

dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /

chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed

do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dran pa nye bar

gzhag pa tshad myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba tshad myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba tshad myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad med do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med do/ /kau shi ka dbang po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dbang po rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dbang po tshad myed do/ /dbang po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ /

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stobs rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ stobs tshad myed do/ /stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag tshad med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag tshad myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags

pa'i bden pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa tshad myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan tshad myed do/ /bsam gtan tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka byams pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byams pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byams pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir byams pa tshad myed do/ /byams pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de

ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ snying rje tshad myed do/ /snying rje tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med do/ /kau shi ka dga' ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dga' ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dga' ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dga' ba tshad myed do/ /dga' ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka btang snyoms tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar btang snyoms kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du btang snyoms kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ btang snyoms tshad myed do/ /btang snyoms tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs myed pa'i

snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa tshad myed do/ /rnam paRa thar pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe

na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mngon par shes pa tshad myed do/ /mngon par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin tshad myed do/ ting nge 'dzin tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo tshad myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myi 'jigs pa tshad myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so

so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ so so yang dag par rig pa tshad myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje chen po'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ snying rje chen po tshad myed do/ /snying rje chen po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa tshad myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'

sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha

rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bco lnga pa/ /kau shi ka gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir gzugs dpag tu myed do/ /gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshor ba'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir tshor ba dpag tu myed do/ /tshor ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du shes dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du shes kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka

'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du shes kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir 'du shes dpag tu myed do/ /'du shes dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du byed dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du byed kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir 'du byed dpag tu myed do/ /'du byed dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myig dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/

shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dpag

tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/

dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni
