dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ /nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dpag tu myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba dpag tu myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpag tu myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dbang po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper

na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dbang po rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir dbang po dpag tu myed do/ /dbang po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stobs rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir stobs dpag tu myed do/ /stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag dpag tu myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/

kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dpag tu med do/ /'phag pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dpag tu med do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dpag tu myed do/ /bsam gtan dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka byams pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byams pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du

byams pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byams pa dpag tu myed do/ /byams pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu med pa'i phyir snying rje dpag tu myed do/ /snying rje dpag tu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dga' ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dga' ba'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dga' ba'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu med pa'i phyir dga' ba dpag tu myed do/ /dga' ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med do/ /kau shi ka btang snyoms dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar btang snyoms kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du btang snyoms kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ btang snyoms dpag tu myed do/ /btang snyoms dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa dpag tu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau

shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dpag tu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ mngon par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /mngon par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/

nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin dpag tu myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med do/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dpag tu myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs

su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ myi 'jigs pa dpag tu myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ so so yang dag par rig pa dpag tu myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje chen po'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir snying rje chen po dpag tu myed do/ /snying rje chen po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs

su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dpag tu myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed do/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ thams cad shes pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid

kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu drug pa// //kau shi ka gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du shes mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du shes kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du byed mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau

shi ka myig mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sgra mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka

de ni 'di ltar sgra'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dri mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dri'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ro mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ro'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka reg mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg gi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chos mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig gi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i

phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te

reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus mi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i

rkyend kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang / dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sa'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chu'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mye'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mye'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rlung gi khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rlung gi khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams kyi

mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ma rig pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ma rig pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du byed mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mying dang gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka skye mched drug mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug gi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sred pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sred pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka len pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar len pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka srid pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar srid pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka skye ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rga shi mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rga shi'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa

nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/

kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dbang po mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams kyi mtha'

dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka stobs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshad myed pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshad myed pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha'

yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de

ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mi 'jigs pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka byams pa chen po mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byams pa chen po'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid mtha'

yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gzugs mtha' yas pa dang / tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / 'du shes mtha' yas pa dang / 'du byed mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / myig mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba mtha' yas pa dang / sna mtha' yas pa dang / lce mtha' yas pa dang / lus mtha' yas pa dang / yid mtha' yas pa dang / gzugs mtha' yas pa dang / sgra mtha' yas pa dang / dri mtha' yas pa dang / ro mtha' yas pa dang / reg mtha' yas pa dang / chos mtha' yas ba dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te

reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / sa'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / chu'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / mye'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / rlung gi khams mtha' yas pa dang / nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / ma rig pa mtha' yas pa dang / 'du byed mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / mying dang gzugs mtha' yas pa dang / skye mched drug mtha' yas pa dang / reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / sred pa mtha' yas pa dang / len pa mtha' yas pa dang / srid pa mtha' yas pa dang / skye ba mtha' yas pa dang / rga shi mtha' yas pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa

dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams mtha' yas pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / dbang po rnams mtha' yas pa dang / stobs rnams mtha' yas pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mtha' yas pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mtha' yas pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / bsam gtan rnams mtha' yas pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad mtha' yas pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtha' yas pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams mtha' yas pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mtha' yas pa dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi mtha' yas pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi mtha' yas pa dang / byams pa chen po mtha' yas pa dang / snying rje chen po mtha' yas pa

dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad mtha' yas pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mtha' yas pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtha' yas pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtha' yas pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rang byang chub mtha' yas pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brgya byin kyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhes bya/ /rab 'byord kyis smras pa/ kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang chos dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na chos dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhes bya/ /rab 'byord kyis smras pa/ kau shi ka chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems

dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang de bzhin nyid dang dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhes bya/ /rab 'byord kyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir dmyigs pa mtha' yas so/ /dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid mtha' yas so/ /kau shi ka de bzhin nyid dang dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas so/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang sems can mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas so/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na sems can mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa yin zhes bya/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ 'di lta ste sems can sems can zhes bya ba de chos gang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni chos kyi tshig bla dgas kyang ma yin/ chos ma yin pa'i tshig bla dgas kyang me yin te/ 'di ltar sems can sems can zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du btags pa/ dngos po myed par mying du btags

pa/ dmyigs pa myed par ming du btags pa'o/ /rab 'byord kyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las sems can du bshad pa gang yang yod dam/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni myed do/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka gang la sems can du bshad pa gang yang myed pa de la/ sems can mtha' yas pa yod de/ kau shi ka gal te de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bzhugs te/ sems can sems can zhes gsung du brjod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ de la sems can gang yang skye ba 'am/ 'gag par gyur pa yod dam/ /smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni myed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can thog ma nas rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ltar rnam grangs des na/ sems can mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /de nas dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / skyes pa dang bud myed du bcas pa dag gis lan gsum du ched du brjod pa ched du brjod de gang gnas brtan rab 'byor gyis 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bshad cing brjod de/ bstan pa'i chos 'di ni kye ma legs par bshad do/ /kye ma chos 'di legs par bshad do/ /kye ma chos kyi chos nyid ni legs par bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dang ma bral ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gzung bar bgyi'o/ /chos gang yang dmyigs su ma mchis te/ gzugs sam/ tshor ba 'am/

'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa 'am/ myig gam/ rna ba 'am/ sna 'am/ lce 'am/ lus sam/ yid dam/ gzugs sam/ sgra 'am/ dri'am/ ro 'am/ reg gam/ chos sam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa 'am rna ba'i rnam par shes pa 'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa 'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa 'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'am/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa 'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa 'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa 'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa 'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa 'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ sa'i khams sam/ chu'i khams sam/ mye'i khams sam/ rlung gi khams sam/ nam mkha'i khams sam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams sam/ ma rig pa 'am/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'am/ mying dang gzugs sam/ skye mched drug gam/ reg pa'am/ tshor ba'am/ sred pa'am/ len pa'am/ srid pa'am/ skye ba'am/ rga shi'am/ sbyin pa'i pha rold du phyind pa'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ nang stong pa nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ dor

ba myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sam/ dbang po rnams sam/ stobs rnams sam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sam/ bsam gtan rnams sam/ tshad myed pa rnams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa rnams sam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sam/ byams pa chen po 'am/ snying rje chen po 'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub 'am/ thams cad shes pa nyid dam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dam/ chos gang yang dmyigs su ma mchis kyis kyang theg pa gsum rnam par dgod pa mchis te/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu dbang po dang bcas pa rnams la bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu dag de de bzhin

no/ ji skad smras pa de bzhin no/ /chos gang yang dmyigs su myed de/ gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa 'am/ myig gam/ rna ba 'am/ sna 'am/ lce 'am/ lus sam/ yid dam/ gzugs sam/ sgra 'am/ dri 'am/ ro 'am/ reg gam/ chos sam/ myig gi rnam par shes pa'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa 'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa 'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa 'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa 'am/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa 'am/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa 'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa 'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa 'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa 'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ sa'i khams sam/ chu'i khams sam/ mye'i khams sam/ rlung gi khams sam/ nam mkha'i khams sam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams sam/ ma rig pa 'am/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa 'am/ mying dang gzugs sam/ skye mched drug gam/ reg pa 'am/ tshor ba 'am/ sred pa 'am/ len pa 'am/ srid pa 'am/ skye ba 'am/ rga shi 'am/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'am/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'am/ nang stong pa nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus

ma byas stong pa nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dam/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sam/ dbang po rnams sam/ stobs rnams sam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sam/ bsam gtan rnams sam/ tshad myed pa rnams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa rnams sam/ mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sam/ byams pa chen po 'am/ snying rje chen po'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dam/ chos gang yang myi dmyigs mod kyi/ theg pa gsum rnam par dgod pa yang yod de/ gsum gang zhe na/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / Rang sangs rgyas kyi thag pa dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'o/ /

lha'i bu dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dang ma bral ba de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gzung bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las theg pa gsum rgya cher bstan te/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa bshad do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /

thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa mi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi

dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /byams pa chen po las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad shes pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las gzhan du yang de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs so// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bdun pa/ /lha'i bu dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni chos 'di dag thams cad la slob ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa la slob bo/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu

phyind pa la slob bo/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob bo/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob bo/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob bo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob bo/ /nang stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /phyi stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /chen po stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la slob bo/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la slob bo/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams la slob bo/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la slob bo/ /dbang po rnams la slob bo/ /stobs rnams la slob bo/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la slob bo/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la slob bo/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la slob bo/ /bsam gtan rnams la slob bo/ /tshad myed pa rnams la slob bo/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la slob bo/ /rnam par thar pa rnams la slob bo/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la slob bo/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la slob bo/ /mngon par shes pa rnams la slob bo/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams la slob bo/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la slob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams

la slob bo/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams la slob bo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la slob bo/ /byams pa chen po la slob bo/ /snying rje chen po la slob bo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la slob bo/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la slob bo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la slob bo/ /phyid myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la slob bo/ /dgra bcom pa nyid la slob bo/ /rang byang chub la slob bo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la slob bo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob bo/ /lha'i bu dag de bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dang myi 'bral bar spyod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid ces bya ste/ lha'i bu dag gang gi tshe/ nga de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi zham 'bring byed cing / rgyal po'i khab padmo yod pa'i nang gi tshong dus kyi dbus na 'dug pa'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /nang stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /phyi stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /chen po stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /thog ma dang

tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /dbang po rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /stobs rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /bsam gtan rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /tshad myed pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /rnam par thar pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /byams pa chen po dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /snying rje chen po dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams

dang yang bral bar ma gyur te/ de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag dang yang bral bar ma gyur to/ /lha'i bu dag de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis nga la khye'u khyod ni/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi bskal pa grangs myed pa na/ bskal pa bzang po'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid du shākya thub pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dang rkang par ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ bla na myed pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i/ kha lo sgyur ba/ lha dang myi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur ro zhes/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di de ltar gzugs myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / tshor ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'du shes mi len mi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'du byed myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / myig myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rna ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sna myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lce myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lus myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / yid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / gzugs myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sgra myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / dri myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / ro myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / reg myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / chos myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rna ba'i rnam par

shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba myi lan myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sa'i khams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / chu'i khams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / mye'i khams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rlung gi khams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / nam mkha'i khams mi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / ma rig pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'du byed myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / mying dang gzugs myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / skye mched drug myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / reg pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / tshor ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sred pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / len pa myi len myi 'dor

ba'i tshul dang / srid pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / skye ba myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rga shi myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / nang stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams

myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / dbang po rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / stobs rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / bsam gtan rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / tshad myed pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / mngon par shes pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / byams pa chen po myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / snying rje chen po myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / thams cad shes pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshul dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi len myi 'dor ba'i tshuld gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mthun par yongs su 'dzin pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma'i

'khor bzhi dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i bu dang / mtshe ma'i lha'i bu dang / dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu dang / 'phrul dga'i lha'i bu dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu dang / tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu dang / tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha'i bu dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha'i bu dang / tshangs chen gyi lha'i bu dang / snang ba'i lha'i bu dang / chung snang gi lha'i bu dang / tshad myed snang ba'i lha'i bu dang / kun snang dang ba'i lha'i bu dang / dge ba'i lha'i bu dang / chung dge'i lha'i bu dang / tshad myed dge ba'i lha'i bu dang / dge rgyas kyi lha'i bu dang / che ba'i lha'i bu dang / chung che'i lha'i bu dang / tshad myed che ba'i lha'i bu dang / 'bras bu che ba'i lha'i bu dang / myi che ba'i lha'i bu dang / myi gdung ba'i lha'i bu dang / shin tu mthong ba'i lha'i bu dang / gya nom snang ba'i lha'i bu dang / 'og myin gyi lha'i bu de dag 'dus shing tshogs par mkhyen nas/ de dag thams cad dpang du btsugs te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma 'am/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo 'am/ lha'i bu 'am/ lha'i bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / sgom pa dang / gzhan la rgya cher 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang yang / myi 'bral ba de dag ni/ bdud sdig can dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis glags rnyed par myi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ gzugs

stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ tshor ba stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ 'du shes stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ 'du byed stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ rnam par shes pa stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid kyis stong pa nyid la glags myi rnyhed/ mtshan ma myed pas mtshan ma myed pa la glags myi rnyhed do/ /smon pa myed pas smon pa myed pa la glags myi rnyhed do/ /de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ myig stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ rna ba stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ sna stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ lce stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ lus stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ yid stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid kyis stong pa nyid la glags myi rnyhed/ mtshan ma myed pas/ mtshan ma myed pa la glags myi rnyhed/ smon pa myed pas/ smon pa myed pa la glags myi rnyhed do/ /de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ gzugs stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ sgra stong pa nyid shin tu byin kyis brlabs par 'gyur/ dri stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ ro stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ reg stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ chos stong pa nyid shin tu byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid kyis stong pa nyid la glags myi rnyhed/ mtshan ma myed pas mtshan ma myed pa la glags myi rnyhed/ smon pa myed pas smon pa myed pa la glags myi rnyhed do/ /
