bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad gyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad gyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis nang stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka nang stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis phyi stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka phyi stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis phyi nang stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi

skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis chen po stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka chen po stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis don dam pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'dus byas stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rang bzhin stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis chos thams cad stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi

ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ /lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / Rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis yang dag par spong ba rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka yang dag par spong ba 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/

lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dbang po rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka dbang po 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis stobs rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka stobs 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems

dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin node dag gis bsam gtan rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka bsam gtan 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis tshad myed pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka tshad myed pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rnam par thar pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka rnam par thar pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /

smon pa myed pa la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'di dag ni/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis mngon par shes pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka mngon par shes pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ting nge 'dzin rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka ting nge 'dzin 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis gzungs kyi sgo rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka gzungs kyi sgo 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yan te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis myi 'jigs pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka myi 'jigs pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams

cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis snying rje chen po la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka snying rje chen po 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis thams cad shes pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i

phyir zhe na/ koo shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gcig pa/ //kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i phyir/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa byas te/ de la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi mye tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / gzhan la yang rgya cher ston cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang myi 'bral la/ gong du me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs

kyis rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams de ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka mchod rten gcig lta zhog gi /kau shi ka gal te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling 'di rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang myi 'bral la/ gong du me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams

de ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi /kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod pa'i phyir gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi mye tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas te 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / bris shing mye tog dang phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten

gyi khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi /kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i phyir/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byur bu 'di rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / bris shing mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byur bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su

bkang ba lta zhog gi /kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po stong gnyis pa 'di rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo/ gang shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po stong gnyis pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi /kau shi ka gal te

rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod pa'i phyir stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun pas byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ /bkur bstir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin par byed/ 'chang bar byed/ klog par byed kun chub par byed tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten kyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag

las sems can re res/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i phyir/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag byas te/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas pa bas/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par byas pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byas pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang yang ma bral bar byas te/ de la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ de nyid bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de de lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de de lags te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rim gror bgyis pa dang / bkur stir bgyis pa dang / phu dud du bgyis pa dang / mchod par bgyis pas ni/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams rim gror bgyis pa dang / bkur stir bgyis pa dang / phu dud du bgyis pa dang / mchod

par bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod pa'i slad du rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis ste/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su

mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal ba'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag

la bskal ba 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las/ sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang /

lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal

mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi phye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa'i lhag mar lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis na/ bcom ldan 'das de la ji ltar dgongs/ de'i slad du rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi bsod nams mang du 'phel ba lags sam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka mang ngo / /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bas kyang rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid cing / de la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das

shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di'i nang du dge ba'i chos thams cad 'dus te/ 'di ltar dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / Rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gsum dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa

bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / thams cad shes pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang 'dus so/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bstan pa ste/ de la bslabs shing 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur to/ /phyin to/ /phyin par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bcwo brgyad do// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mod dag gi /bsod nams mang du 'phel lo/ /gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing / glegs bam du byas te/ 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / gong du me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi bsod nams ni tshad myed grangs myed/ bsam gyis myi khyab/ mtshungs pa myed/ dpag tu myed par 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam pa thams

cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ nang stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ phyi stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ chen po stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid

do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dbang po rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ stobs rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bsam gtan rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ tshad myed pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ myi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ byams pa chen po'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ snying rje chen po'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan lnga'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ sems can yongs su smin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'o/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ theg pa chen po'o/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris te/ glegs bam du byas shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byas/ /

bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba 'di la bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba snga mas brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /stong gi cha dang / brgya phrag stong gi cha dang / bye ba'i cha dang / bye ba brgya'i cha dang / bye ba stong gi cha dang / bye ba brgya phrag stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dper yang nye bar myi 'gro/ /rgyur yang nye bar myi bzod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ji srid du/ 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa de srid du sangs rgyas dkon mchog nub par myi 'gyur ro/ /chos dkon mchog nub par myi 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog nub par myi 'gyur ro/ /de srid du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa lnga 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong /

pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur

ro/ /rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas ba'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byams pa chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad shes pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de srid du rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung

bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung snang gi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung dge'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung che'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / phyir myi 'ong ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'byung ba yod do/ /bla na myed

pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yod do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yod do/ /sems can yongs su smin pa yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa yod do/ de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma'i lha rnams dang / dga' ldan gyi lha rnams dang / 'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams dang / tshangs chen gyi lha rnams dang / snang ba'i lha rnams dang / chung snang gi lha rnams dang / tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams dang / kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams dang / dge ba'i lha rnams dang / chung dge'i lha rnams dang / tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams dang / dge rgyas kyi lha rnams dang / che ba'i lha rnams dang / chung che'i lha rnams dang / tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams dang / myi che ba'i lha rnams dang / myi gdung ba'i lha rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams dang / gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams dang / 'og myin gyi lha gang ji snyed yod pa de dag la/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis smras pa/ grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gzung bar bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bcang bar bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa klag par bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun chub par bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul bzhin du yid la bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par byas pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byas

pas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun 'chad par myi 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi tshul rgyun 'chad par myi 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun gyi tshul rgyun 'chad par myi 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun ma chad la/ grogs po dag chos kyi tshul rgyun ma chad de/ grogs po dag dge 'dun gyi tshul rgyun ma chad na/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po

myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'jig rten du

'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyi da 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang byang chub 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di zungs shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub bar gyis shig /kau shi ka khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka nam lha ma yin rnams 'di snyam du sems shing / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang 'thab mo bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang tsham bsngal lo snyam na/ de'i tshe kau shi ka khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yid kyis soms la kha ton gyis shig /tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig dang / des lha ma yin gyi bsam pa de dag phyir nub par 'gyur te/ sems bskyed pa de dag zlos shing / rnam par 'phel bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu dang lha'i bu mo gang dag shi 'pho ba'i tshe/ nam bdag cag ngan song du skye bar mthong na yang / kau shi ka khyod kyis de dag gi mdun du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du gyis shig dang / de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mos pas/ lha'i gnas de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa ni de ltar don dang ldan

pa ste/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang su yang rung ste/ gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ mthar kyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig byung ba de dag thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la bslabs nas/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /ma byon pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig 'byung ba de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos gyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i nang du nyan thos kyi chos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos sam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang rung ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad 'dus so/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rig sngags chen mo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bla na med pa'i rigs sngags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rig sngags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myi dge ba'i chos thams cad spong ba'o/ /dge ba'i chos thams cad sgrub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ de de bzhin te/ kau shi ka 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rig sngags chen mo'o/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bla na myed pa'i rig sngags so/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rig sngags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig byung ba de dag kyang rig sngags 'di nyid la brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /ma byon pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag kyang rig sngags 'di nyid la brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang rig sngags 'di nyid la brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar

rig sngags 'di yod na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ tshad myed pa bzhi 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa lnga 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dran pa nye bar

gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dbang po rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ stobs rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ byams pa chen po 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ snying rje chen po 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos kyi dbyings 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ yang dag pa'i mtha' 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ de bzhin nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos kyi gnas nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos skyon myed pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ myig lnga 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu

'jig rten na yod pa yin/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dgra bcom pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rang byang chub 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gnyis pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' yod na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ tshad myed pa bzhi 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa lnga 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags

su yod pa yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dbang po rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ stobs rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rnam par thar ba'i stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams

'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ snying rje chen po 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ phyir myi 'ong ba 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dgra bcom pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rang sangs rgyas 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin no/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yod na/ rtsi dang rgyu skar dang / skar ma thams cad gdags su yod do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yod na/ dge ba'i spyod pa dang / yang dag pa'i spyod pa dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / pha rold tu phyind pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa

dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang / stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i rtsa thams cad gdags su yod do/ /slob pa dang / myi slob pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu skar dang / skar ma thams cad kyang gdags su yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'jig rten na yod par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten du ma byung ba de'i tshe na yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can rnams la 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po rnams te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pa gang dang ldan pas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dor ba

myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / Rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la spyod pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyod pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la spyod pa dang / dbang po rnams la spyod pa dang / stobs rnams la spyod pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la spyod pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan rnams la spyod pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la spyod pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la spyod pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la spyod pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams la spyod pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la spyod pa dang / snying rje chen po la spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la spyod pa dang / nyan thos kyi sar myi ltung ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis mngon du myi byed pa dang / sems can yongs su smyin par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed pa dang / tshe phun sum tshogs pa

yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sems can phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rjes su thob par byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung bar rig par bya'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de ni tshe 'di'i yon tan 'di dag dang / tshe rabs gzhan kyi yon tan 'di dag dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de tshe 'di'i yon tan gang dang ldan par 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs par dug gis dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /mtshon gyis dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /myes dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /chus dus byed par myi 'gyur ba nas/ nad brgya rtsa gcig gi bar gyis dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang / blon pos gnod par bya ba zhig byung ba las/ gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton byed cing / rgyal po'i pho brang du

song na/ de la glags tshol ba de dag gis glags myi rnyed de/ rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po chen po dag kyang gtam dri ba dang / gtam bya bar sems shing dga' bar bya bar sems par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid kyi gzi brjid dang / mthus de ltar sems so/ /gal te rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton byed cing / rgyal po'i pho brang du song na/ de la rgyal po'i bu 'am/ rgyal po'i blon po chen po dag kyang dga' ba'i tshig gis gtam dri ba dang / gtam bya bar sems shing / dga' bar bya bar sems par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems nye bar gzhag /snying rje'i sems dang / dga' ba'i sems dang / btang snyoms kyi sems nye bar gzhag pa'i phyir te/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa ni/ tshe 'di'i yon tan de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka tshe rabs gzhan gyi yon tan gang dag dang ldan par 'gyur zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nam yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams dang bral bar myi 'gyur te/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / lam rnams dang / 'phags pa'i

bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad myed pa rnams dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa rnams dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de sems can rnams yongs su smyin par bya ba'i smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs par nam yang sems can dmyal bar myi skye/ byol song gi skye gnas su myi skye/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du myi skye'o/ /de nam yang yan lag nyams pa can du myi 'gyur/ nam yang dbul po'i rigs su myi skye/ smyig ma mkhan gyi rigs sam/ smye sha can gyi rigs sam/ mgar ba 'am/ phyag dar ba 'am/ shen pa'am/ phag gsod pa'i rigs sam/ dmangs rigs su myi skye ste/ rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu rdzus shing skye bar 'gyur te/ nam yang byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa dang 'bral bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba dang / chos nyan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur te/ de sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / sems can rnams kyang yongs su smyin par byed/ sangs

rgyas kyi zhing yang yongs su dag par byed do/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo yon tan 'di dag phun sum tshogs par 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ klag par bya/ kun chub par bya/ tshul bzhin du yid la bya/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byas te/ de dag ni nam bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du/ tshe 'di'i yon tan dang / tshe rabs gzhan gyi yon tan/ de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u bcu dgu'o// //de nas mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba/ glags lta ba'i bsam pa can brgya tsam zhig /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su dong ba dang / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba brgya po glags lta ba'i bsam pa can 'di dag /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong na/ de la bdag gis ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brjod pas/ mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du dong nas/ bar chad byed par myi 'gyur bar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las ji snyed cig bzung ba de dag kha ton du bya'o snyam nas/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ji snyed cig bzung ba de dag kha ton du brjod do/ /de nas mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba de dag rgyang ring po ring po nas/ bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir

dong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di snyam du gyur te/ de ltar mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba de dag gis rgyang ring po ring po nas/ bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir dod na de ci'i rgyu zhig snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu'i sems kyi kun tu rtog pa thugs kyis thugs su chud nas/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsams pas/ de'i phyir mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag rgyang ring po ring po nas/ nga la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir dong ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag las 'ga' tsam la yang dkar po'i sems dang ldan pa ma mthong ste/ mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag thams cad ni gnod par bya ba'i sems dang ldan pa glags lta ba'i bsam pa can sha stag ste/ 'khor 'dir 'ong bar sems pa sha stag kyang / sha ra dwa ti'i bu ngas ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs par bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu'i nang na gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ zhe sdang ba'i sems sam/ glags lta ba'i bsam pas nye bar 'gro ba ma mthong ste/ de ni gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni 'di ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang / tshangs pa kun

'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad myed snang ba dang / kun snang dang ba dang / dge ba dang / chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang / chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya nom snang ba dang / 'og myin gyi lha gang ji snyed cig yod pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig yod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa
