de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /

nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang /

rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go /de nas bdud sdig to can 'di snyam du sems par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khor bzhi po 'di dag kyang mngon tu gyur/ 'dod pa na spyod pa dang / gzugs na spyod pa'i lha 'di dag kyang mngon du gyur pa las 'dir ni gdon mi za bar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par 'gyur gyis/ de la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ bar chad bya'o/ snyam nas bdud sdig to can gyis/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi ba mngon par sprul nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'gro 'dod par gyur pa dang / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems par gyur to/ /kye ma bdud sdig to can 'di dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa mngon par sprul cing / bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'gro bar 'dod la bdud sdig to can gyi dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi rnam par bkod pa 'di ni rgyal po bim bi sa ra'i dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa rnam par bkod pas kyang de tsam myi phod/ rgyal po sde rab tu 'pham byed dang / shākya rnams dang / lid tsa byi rnams kyi dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa rnam par bkod pas kyang de tsam myi phod de/ bdud sdig to can 'di ni yun ring po nas bcom ldan 'das la yang glags lta zhing / glags tshol/ sems can yang dag par brtson pa rnams la yang gtse ba'i bsam pa can yin gyis/ bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang dag par bsam par bya'o/ /dran pas brjod par bya'o snyam nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang dag par bsams te/ dran pas gsal bar brjod pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis ji lta ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gsal bar brjod pa de lta de ltar bdud sdig to can

de dag lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir log go /de nas 'khor de na rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang / 'og myin gyi lha'i bar du ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag gis lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / na bza' mang po mngon par sprul nas/ bar snang gi nam mkha' la 'khod bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der gtor te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der mngon par gtor nas/ tshig 'di skad du brjod do/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi myi 'di rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la yun ring por spyod par gyur cig /'dzam bu'i gling gi myi 'di dag ji srid du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur zhe'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams ji srid du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa de srid du stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur 'gyur zhe'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa yang yod par 'gyur zhe'o/ /phyogs gang na rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing glegs bam du byas te/ 'chang ba'i phyogs de ni snang ba dang ldan par rig par bya'o/ /phyogs de ni mgon dang bcas shing mun pa dang bral bar rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / 'og myin gyi bar gyi

lha'i bu de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ lha'i bu dag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji srid du 'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gyi bar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa yang yod par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs gang na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing glegs bam du byas te/ 'chang ba'i phyogs de ni snang ba dang ldan par ngas shes so/ /phyogs de ni mgon dang bcas shing mun pa dang bral bar ngas shes so/ /de nas lha'i bu de dag gis lha rdzas kyi me tog mang po mngon par sprul nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der mngon par gtor te/ 'di skad kyi tshig brjod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid cing / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de la bdud dam/ bdud kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha glags tshol ba rnams kyis glags myi rnyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang

rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de la rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bskyang ba bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de ni ston pa 'am/ ston pa dang mtshungs pa tsam du bdag cag sems so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dma' ba dang ldan pa ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la bgyi ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid btsal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ rnam pa

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de la gnyis su ma mchis te/ gnyis su bgyir ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las byung ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u nyi shu'o// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ji ltar shes rab kyi/ pha rold tu phyind pa'i/ mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de

ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma

mdzad/ de ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar dbang po rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar stobs rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar tshad myed pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi mying yang yongs

su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar snying rje chen po'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dag gi thog mar 'gro ba'o/ /kun tu 'dren pa'o/ /kun dga' bo de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i sbyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ci snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i tshul khrims tshul khrims

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ /gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i bzod pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i bsam gtan bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i shes rab shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags na/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsdos pa'i brtson 'grus brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs

su bsngos pa'i shes rab shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs

su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul kyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'du shes gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lus gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / gzugs gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sgra gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dri gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / ro gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / reg gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chos gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg

pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sa'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chu'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mye'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rlung gi khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / nam mkha'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams gnyis su med pa'i tshul dang / ma rig pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mying dang gzugs gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / skye mched drug gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sred pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / len pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / srid pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / skye ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rga shi gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / nang stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'dus ma

byas stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / Rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dbang po rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / stobs rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bsam gtan rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshad myed pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mthard dkyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mngon par shes pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul

dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / snying rje chen po gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dgra bcom pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / Rang byang chub gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gzugs gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'du shes gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'du byed gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myig gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar gzugs gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sgra gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dri gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ro gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar reg gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chos gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /

ji ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sa'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chu'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mye'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rlung gi khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar nam mkha'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par

shes pa'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ma rig pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'du byed gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mying dang gzugs gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar skye mched drug gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sred pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar len pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar srid pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar skye ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rga shi gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar nang stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar phyi stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chen po stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gnyis

su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dbang po rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar stobs rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bsam gtan rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshad myed pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par thar pa brgyad gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par

'jug pa dgu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mngon par shes pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang ji ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi 'jigs pa bzhi gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar snying rje chen po gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dgra bcom pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rang byang chub gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul gyis lags// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gsum pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ 'di ltar gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs dang pha rold tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed

de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'du shes ni 'du shes kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'du shes dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'du byed dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myig ni myig gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba ni rna bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sna ni snas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce ni lces stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus ni lus kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lus dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid ni yid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ca'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sgra ni sgras stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sgra dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag

gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dri ni dris stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dri dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ro ni ros stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ro dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /reg ni reg gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar reg dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chos ni chos kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par

shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed

de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rold tu phyind pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sa'i khams ni sa'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chu'i khams ni chu'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mye'i khams ni mye'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mye'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rlung gi khams ni rlung gi khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rlung gi khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /

nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ma rig pa ni ma rig pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ma rig pa dang pha rol phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'du byed dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /reg pa ni reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sred pa ni sredapas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sred pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /len pa ni len pas

stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar len pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /srid pa ni sridapas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar srid pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /skye ba ni skye bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar skye ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rga shi ni rga shis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rga shi dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyind pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol

tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni mtha' las

'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de

ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /stobs rnams ni stobs rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lam ni lam gyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lam dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i

bden pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni tshad myed pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshad myed pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon

par shes pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myi 'jigs pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /snying rje chen po ni snying rje chen pos stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/

de ni 'di ltar rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dgra bcom pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rang byang chub ni rang byang chub kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rang byang chub dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi

pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /bsam gtan bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /tshad med pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /snying rje chen po'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid

kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa nyid do/ /kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na/ sa chen po la sa bon btab pa/ rgyu rkyen tshogs par gyur nas/ rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba yang / sa chen po ni de dag gi gnas te/ sa chen po la brten cing sa bon de dag skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la brten cing pha rold tu phyind pa lnga po 'di dag rnam par 'phel lo/ /nang stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /phyi stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /chen po stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /dbang po rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /stobs rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /

bsam gtan rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /tshad myed pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par 'phel lo/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnam par 'phel lo/ /mngon par shes pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rnam par 'phel lo/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /snying rje chen po rnam par 'phel lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad rnam par 'phel lo/ /thams cad shes pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam par 'phel te/ kun dga' bo rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / pha rold tu phyind pa lnga rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / stong pa nyid thams cad rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / dbang po lnga rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing /

stobs lnga rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / bsam gtan bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / tshad myed pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / mngon par shes pa rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / ting nge 'dzin rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / gzungs kyi sgo rnams rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / myi 'jigs pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing /

snying rje chen po rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / thams cad shes pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rten cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /stong pa nyid thams cad yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /dbang po lnga yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /stobs lnga yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /tshad myed pa bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs

su sgrub pa'o/ /snying rje chen po yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /thams cad shes pa nyid yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su sgrub pa'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan gang bdag gis/ bcom ldan 'das las thos te/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa'i yon tan gang ji snyed cig mchis pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i yon tan gang ji snyed cig bdag gis bcom ldan 'das las bzung ste/ bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par bgyis pa dang / spel ba de dag thams cad bka' ma stsal te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / spel ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyis pas ni/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa lnga 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu

phyind pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lnga 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs lnga 'jig rten du 'byung

bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par bgyis pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyis pas ni/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /gzhan 'phrul

dbang byed kyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /chung snang gi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /chung dge'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /chung che'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par bgyis pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyis pas ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /dgra bcom pa rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'jig rten na mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par bgyis pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyis pas ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags pa dang / kun chub par byas pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byas pa de'i yon tan ni der zad par yang ma bshad de/ kau shi ka de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byed pa de dag ni/ tshul khrims kyi phung po tshad myed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byed pa de dag ni ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po tshad myed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byed pa de dag ni shes rab kyi phung po tshad myed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang /

tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byed pa de dag ni/ rnam par grol pa'i phung po tshad myed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byed pa de dag ni/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po tshad myed pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byed pa de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i don du zhugs par rig par bya'o/ /kau shi ka nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po dang / gang yang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po las/ kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po 'di la ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par

grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung pos brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /grangs su yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /bgrang bar yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /dper yang myi 'gro'o/ /rgyur yang myi bzod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis las/ sems rnam par grol yang chos gang yang yongs su shes pa myed do/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis de la rim gror byed pa dang / bkur bstir byed pa dang / phu dud du byed pa dang / mchod par byed pa de dag tshe 'di nyid dang / tshe rabs phyi ma la yon tan de dag rnam pa de bzhin du thob par ngas bshad do/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar bgyid pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di bris shing

me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyid pa dang / bkur stir bgyid pa dang / phu dud du bgyid pa dang / mchod par bgyid pa de la ni bdag gis kyang rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byed pa'i tshe/ lha'i bu brgya stong mang po dga' ba'i yid kyis chos nyan pa'i phyir nye bar 'ongs te/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos ston pa'i tshe yang / lha'i bu de dag spobs pa nye bar bsgrub par sems so/ /chos smra ba de dag smra ba snyom par gyur na yang / lha'i bu de dag chos kyi rim gror de nyid kyis spobs pa nye bar bsgrub par sems te/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / bris shing me tog dang / phreng ba dang / bdug spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed pa dang / bkur stir byed pa dang / phu dud du byed pa dang / mchod par byed pa de dag gis tshe 'di'i yon tan 'di yang yongs su zin par 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag 'khor bzhi la shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa ston pa'i tshe/ la la zhig bdag la glan ka tshol zhing glags lta bar 'gyur du 'ong ngo / zhes bya bar zhum pa myed par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i
