pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mang pos cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum la bzhugs te/ mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / chos gtan la bab pa bstan pa gsungs te/ bshad pa dang / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung zhing / kun chub par bgyis te/ gzhan la bstan pa de gnyis kyang myi 'dra ba ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di las byung ba ni phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum mo/ /'di las byung ba ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / chos gtan la bab pa bstan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bgyis pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di glegs bam du bris shing / me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /

byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bgyis pa yang myi 'dra ba ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid cing / gzhan la yang rgya cher ston pa des ni/ sems can dmyal ba'i rgyud kyi dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi rgyud kyi dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /nyan thos kyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo/ de ni phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin to/ /'chang ngo / /klog go /kun chub par bgyid do/ /tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid do/ /bris pa de la yang me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyid/ bkur stir bgyid/ phu dud du bgyid/ mchod par bgyid/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar bgyid pa'o/ /nad thams cad rab tu sel ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang rigs kyi bu' ma rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / de la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod par bgyid pa des ni/ gang nas kyang 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu nor gyi bdag po zhig 'jigs nas rgyal po la gnas shing / rgyal po la rten na/ de rgyal po la gnas shing / rgyal po la rten pas/ sus 'jigs pa de dag nyid kyang de la rten pas/ de dag gis 'jigs par myi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar gsha' ste/ gang rgyal po la rten pa ni mthu dang ldan pa la rten pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pas yongs su bsgrubs pas na/ mchod pa mang 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gang lags pa de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su bsgrubs par blta'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bas na/ bdag gis cha de gnyis las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid blang bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'o/ /'di las byung ba ni myi 'jigs pa bzhi'o/ /'di las byung ba ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'o/ /'di las byung ba

ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad do/ /'di las byung ba ni byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di las byung ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga ste/ de dag pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 'thob bo/ /'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du ste/ bcom ldan 'das grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khams sam/ rgyal po'i gnas sam/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / de bris shing rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bgyis pa de dag tu myi 'am myi ma lags pa glags lta zhing glags tshol ba rnams kyis/ glags rnyed par myi 'gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang theg pa gsum las theg pa gang yang rung bas/ mthar kyis yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i chos can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don chen po dang ldan pa ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de ltar sems can rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi don du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams gang na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mchis pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams der ni/ sangs rgyas byung ba dang 'dra bar blta'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper na/ nor bu rin po che chen po myi dpogs rin chen ces bgyi ba mchis te/ de ni nor bu rin po che chen po'i yon tan rnam pa 'di lta bu dag dang ldan te/ nor bu rin po che chen po de gang dang gang du bzhag pa de dang der myi ma lags pa rnams kyis glags myi rnyed do/ /myi ma lags pas zin pa'i skyes pa 'am bud myed

kyang nor bu rin po che de bstan na/ myi ma lags pa de nor bu rin po che chen po de'i gzi brjid myi bzod de/ myur du 'pho zhing myi gnas so/ /mkhris pas gdungs pa'i lus la nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ mkhris pa de yang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung gis mnar ba'i lus la/ nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ rlung de yang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan gyis non pa'i lus la nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ bad kan de yang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa'i bros btab pa'i lus la/ nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ 'dus pa'i bro de yang zhi bar 'gyur zhing rnam par myi 'phel lo/ /nub mo ni snang bar bgyid do/ /tsha ba'i dus na ni nor bu rin po che chen po de phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i phyogs de bsil bar bgyid do/ /grang ba'i dus na ni nor bu rin po che chen po de phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i phyogs de dro bar bgyid do/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de dog sa'i phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i phyogs de yang ha cang yang myi dro/ /ha cang yang myi grang zhing / ran pa phun sum tshogs par bgyid do/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de dog sa'i phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i dog sa'i phyogs der sbrul lam de ma lags pa'i sdig pa la stsogs pa gdug pa gzhan dag kyang rgyu bar myi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes pa 'am/ bud myed la la zhig sbrul gdug pas zin pa la/ nor bu rin po che chen po de bstan na/ des de mthong ma thag tu dug de yang 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de ni/ yon tan gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag dang ldan te/ skyes pa 'am/ bud med la la zhig 'brum bus btab bam/ myig rab rib can du gyur te/ myig gi nad dam/ rna ba'i nad dam/

sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ lkog ma'i nad dam/ lus kyi nad ci byung ba las de'i lus la nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ de dag gi 'brum bu'am/ rab rib bam/ myig gi nad dam/ rna ba'i nad dam/ sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ lkog ma'i nad dam/ lus kyi nad de dag kyang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de ni yon tan gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag dang yang ldan te/ gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de/ chab rnyogs pa can gyi nang du stsal na/ de'i mod la chab de thams cad kyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan zhing kha dog gcig par 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos sngon pos dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos ser pos dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos dmar pos dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de/ gos dkar pos dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos leb rgan gyis dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de/ shel gyi kha dog gi gos kyis dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de dag dang gos gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ nor bu rin po che chen po de dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /chab de la rnyogs pa mchis pa yang nor bu

rin po che chen po des 'dang ste/ bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de ni/ yon tan gyi rnam pa de lta bu dag dang / gzhan yang rnam pa mang po dag dang ldan no/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che chen po de dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/ sdig pa thams cad sel ba'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ nor bu rin po che chen po de lha rdzas shig yin nam/ 'on tam nor bu rin po che chen po de 'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams la yang yod/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de ni lha rdzas te/ btsun pa kun dga' bo/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la/ nor bu rin po che gang yod pa de dag ni chung zhing lci/ lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che chen po de dag ni che zhing yang ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams kyi nor bu rin po che de dag ni lha rdzas ltar yan lag de dag gis yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi nor bu rin po che de dag gis ni/ lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che'i grangs sam/ cha 'am/ bgrang ba 'am/ dpe 'am/ rgyur yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /de nas yang lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de snod la la zhig gi nang du stsal stsal pa las/ snod de nas phyung yang snod de ni nor bu rin po che de'i yon tan gyis yid du mchis par 'gyur te/ gzhan yang snod de la mos pa bskyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gang na mchis pa de'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi lus sam/ sems

kyi sdug bsngal dang / gnod pa myi las gyur pa 'am/ myi ma lags pa las gyur pa thams cad kyang ma mchis par 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po zhes bgyi ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshig bla dgas so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ci snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ci snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i

yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshang ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshang ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang nang stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang phyi stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chen po stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang chen po stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ci snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'dus byas stong

pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag gyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang gi mtshan

nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma

mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dbang po lnga'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dbang po rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dbang po rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das stobs lnga'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ stobs rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / stobs rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bsam

gtan rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / bsam gtan rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das tshad myed pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / tshad myed pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rnam par thar pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das mngon par shes pa rnams kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod

par bgyi ste/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / mngon par shes pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ snying rje chen po'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / snying rje chen po'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo

brgyad kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad shes pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / thams cad shes pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / de bzhin nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung

dag kyang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos kyi dbyings kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi gnas nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos kyi gnas nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos kyi gnas nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos myi 'gyur ba nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos myi 'gyur ba nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos myi 'gyur ba nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i mtha'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ yang dag pa'i mtha'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang yang dag pa'i mtha'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma

mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rtag tu btang snyoms la gnas pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rtag tu btang snyoms la gnas pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rtag tu btang snyoms la gnas pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das myi nyams pa'i chos nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ myi nyams pa'i chos nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / myi nyams pa'i chos nyid kyi snod do/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga' 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rold tu phyind pa rin po che'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang / rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa myi skye myi 'gag pa'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa blang ba ma mchis pa dang / dor ba ma mchis pa'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha

rold tu phyind pa dpri ba dang / bsnan pa ma mchis pa'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa 'ong ba dang / 'gro ba dang / gnas pa ma mchis pa'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa chos nyid kyi snod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa chos nyid kyis yongs su bsgos pa'o/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /gzhan yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis byur bur yongs su bltam pa lta zhog gi /bcom ldan 'das gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis byur bur bltam pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris pa zhig stsal na/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa de gnyis las bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid len to/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung rnams te mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bsgos pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga' ste/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams la rim gror bgyid pa dang / bkur stir

bgyid pa dang / phu dud du bgyid pa dang / mchod par bgyid pa yang dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i mtha' myi dmigs shing / rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba 'am/ bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba 'am/ khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba 'am/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha 'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha 'am/ mtshe ma'i lha 'am/ dga' ldan gyi lha 'am/ 'phrul dga'i lha 'am/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i nang du myi dang lha'i phun sum tshogs pa dang / bde ba myong nas dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis sdug bsngal kyi mthar 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung mchod pa'i 'bras bu ni de tsam du bas gyis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzung zhing bcangs pa dang / blags shing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang

tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lnga yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /stobs lnga yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs

kyi sgo rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ched du bsams te lus yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /lus de dag gis sems can yongs su smin par bgyid par 'gyur te/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i lus sam/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba 'am/ bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba 'am/ khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho bar skyes pa'i lus sam/ brgya byin gyi gzugs sam/ tshangs pa'i gzugs sam/ ngal bso po'i gzugs kyang rung ste/ lus de dag gis sems can yongs su smin par bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyis dang rang sangs rgyas kyis las 'das te/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa thob nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bas na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung la rim gro ma mchis pa yang ma lags/ glo ba mches pa yang ma mchis/ mchod par myi 'tshal ba yang ma lags/ gzung bar myi 'tshal ba yang ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams kyis/ rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bgyis na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos

thams cad kyi rgyu shin tu bstsags pa lags/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang yongs su zin par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams la yang / rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod par bgyis par 'gyur bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad dang grangs ma mchis pa dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag chos kyi sku dang / gzugs kyi sku dang / ye shes kyi skur mthong bar 'tshal zhing / mchod par 'tshal bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid gzung bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/ klag par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi/ mchod par bgyi/ gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par bstan par bgyi/ tshul bzhin du yid la bgyi ste/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo des ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs dang / tshad ma mchis pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa des/ chos nyid du sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag mthong bar 'tshal bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/ klag par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi/ mchod par bgyi/ gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par bstan par bgyi/ chos nyid tshul bzhin du yang yid la bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gnyis po 'di dag ni chos

nyid de/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'dus byas chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / 'dus ma byas chos rnams kyi chos nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das de la 'dus byas chos rnams kyis chos nyid gang lags she na/ nang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / phyi stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / chen po stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i ye shes dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / dbang po lnga'i ye shes dang / stobs lnga'i ye shes dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi ye shes dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ye shes dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / bsam gtan bzhi'i ye shes dang / tshad myed pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi ye shes dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i ye shes dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan

ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa'i ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa lnga'i ye shes dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi ye shes dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad kyi ye shes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i ye shes dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / snying rje chen po'i ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyi ye shes dang / dge ba'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / myi dge ba'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams kyi ye shes gang lags pa de ni/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bgyi'o/ /de la 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi chos nyid gang lags she na/ de ni gang la skye ba ma mchis pa dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang / gnas pa ma mchis pa dang / gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyur ba ma mchis pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang / rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa dang / 'phel ba ma mchis pa dang / 'grib pa ma mchis ba ste/ de ni chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid do/ /chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid gang lags she na/ chos thams cad ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ 'di ni 'dus ma byas chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig byung ba de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /

ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig 'byung ba de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten cing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /da ltar byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed pa dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos gang ji snyed cig byung ba dang / ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos gang ji snyed cig 'byung ba dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gis kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten te/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i dus kyi rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig byung ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig 'byung ba dang / da ltar byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed pa dag na/ rang sangs

rgyas gang ji snyed cig 'khod cing 'tsho skyong ba de dag gis kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten te/ rang byang chub thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di theg pa gsum po thams cad rgya cher bstan te/ de dag kyang mtshan ma myed pa'i tshul dang / dmyigs pa myed pa'i tshul dang / skye ba myed pa'i tshul dang / 'gag pa myed pa'i tshul dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa'i tshul dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa'i tshul dang / len pa myed pa'i tshul dang / 'dor ba myed pa'i tshul dang / dbri ba myed pa'i tshul dang / bsnan pa myed pa'i tshul dang / blang ba myed pa'i tshul dang / spang ba myed pa'i tshul gyis bstan te/ de yang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad kyi tshul gyis bstan gyi/ don dam par ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ring du song ba ma yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul rol ma yin/ pha rol ma yin/ thang du 'dug pa ma yin/ gshong du 'dug pa ma yin/ mnyam pa ma yin/ myi mnyam pa ma yin/ mtshan ma ma yin/ mtshan ma myed pa ma yin/ 'jig rten pa ma yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ma yin/ 'dus byas ma yin/ 'dus ma byas ma yin/ dge ba ma yin/ myi dge ba ma yin/ 'das pa ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa ma yin/ da ltar byung ba ma yin te/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams 'dor ba ma yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu drug pa/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni pha rol tu phyin pa chen po ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa rnams ni/ sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa yang 'tshal te/ sems can du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sems can du gdags par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bdag tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sems can du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /srog tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'gro bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gso bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /skyes bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gang zag tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shed can du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shed bdag tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /byed pa por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshor ba por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shes pa por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mthong ba por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzugs su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'du shes su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'du byed du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rna bar

dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /snar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lcer dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzugs su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sgrar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /drir dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ror dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /reg tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chos su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes par dmigs pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmigs pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sa'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chu'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mye'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rlung gi khams

su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /nam mkha'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ma rig par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'du byed du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mying dang gzugs su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /skye mched drug tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sred par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /len par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /srid par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /skye bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rga shir dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /nang stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /phyi stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chen po stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis

so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dbang po rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /stobs rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bsam gtan rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshad myed pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa

rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /snying rje chen por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rang byang chub tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /byang chub tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos su dmyigs pa ma mchis te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'i tshul du nye bar gnas pa ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang gis dmigs par bgyi ba dang / gang la dmigs par bgyi ba dang / gang du dmyigs par bgyi ba de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid de la ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/ myi dmyigs pa'i tshul du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yun ring por spyod pas des byang chub kyang myi dmyigs na/ sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos lta'ang ci smos/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyi/ de ma lags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan la myi spyod dam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug po kun la 'ang / de myi dmyigs pa'i

tshul gyis spyod de/ des sbyin pa'ang myi dmyigs/ gtong ba'ang myi dmyigs/ len pa'ang myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'ang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims ngan pa 'ang myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'ang myi dmyigs/ bzod pa dang ldan pa 'ang myi dmyigs/ gnod sems kyang myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa 'ang myi dmyigs/ le lo yang myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan yang myi dmyigs/ bsam gtan pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'khrug pa yang myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyang myi dmyigs/ shes rab dang ldan pa yang myi dmyigs/ shes rab 'chal pa yang myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'on kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ gzugs myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'du shes myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myig myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lce myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / gzugs myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sgra myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dri myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ro myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / reg myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chos myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i

tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sa'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chu'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mye'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rlung gi khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / nam mkha'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ma rig pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mying dang gzugs myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / skye mched drug myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sred pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / len pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / srid pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / skye ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rga shi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / bzod pa'i

pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / nang stong pa nyid mi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dbang po lnga myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / stobs lnga myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / bsam

gtan bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshad myed pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa med pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mngon par shes pa lnga myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / snying rje chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dgra bcom pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rang byang chub myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa yongs su gtang ba'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims bsrung ba'i/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro

ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bzod pa yongs su bsgrub pa'i/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug pa'i/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos la rnam par lta ba'i/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi shing rnams lo ma sna tshogs can/ me tog sna tshogs can/ 'bras bu sna tshogs can/ dbyibs sna tshogs can/ chu zheng sna tshogs can du 'khod kyang / de dag gi grib ma la khyad par ram/ bye brag myi dmyigs te/ gzhan du na grib ma grib ma zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bar zad do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su zin pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su yongs su bsngos pa rnams la yang khyad par ram/ bye brag myi dmyigs so/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyidapa'i slad du/ yon tan chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan tshad ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i slad du/ tshad ma mchis pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /

bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan mu ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i slad du/ yon tan kun tu mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing / glegs bam du bgyis te/ bcangs pa dang / mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis te/ de nas gong du ji skad du bstan pa bzhin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la tshul bzhin du yid la bgyis pa dang / rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du bgyis te/ gzhan stsal na/ de gnyis las gang gis bsod nams cher 'phel bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas na khyod nyid la dris/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de ltar lung ston cig /kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung mang po la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod pa byas pa dang / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam zhig gzhan la byin te/ bgo bshar byas pa dang / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ de bzhin gshegs

pa'i sku gdung yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam po de blangs te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ de dag las gang gi bsod nams cher 'phel ba yin/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal te/ de la rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung mang po la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bgyisbkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa bas/ gang la las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam gzhan stsal na/ 'di ni de bas bsod nams cher 'phel lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang / don de nyid gzigs te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshig ste/ sems can gyi ris na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyis/ 'dul ba'i sems can mchis pa rnams kyi slad du/ thugs rje chen po bskyed de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung du byin gyis brlabs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la las/ chung du na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam la mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod pa bgyis na/ de dag thams cad kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i mthar ma thug par sdug bsngal mthar 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kau

shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas pa bas/ gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris te/ chos kyi dga' bas gzhan byin na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ji skad du bstan pa bzhin du gzhan gyi drung du song ste/ bshad cing bstan pa dang / brjod cing bkrol ba dang / rnam par phye ste gsal bar byas na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo snga ma dag pas/ bsod nams cher 'phel te/ de ni ston pa yin par bsam mo/ /bla ma'i gnas mkhas pa tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la la zhig yin par bsam mo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid ston pa yin te/ ston pa ni gzhan shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gzhan zhes bya ba myed kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ston pa/ ston pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs pas/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon

par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa de dag kyang / phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams las gud na myed de/ de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la bslabs shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la bslabs shing / nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing / rang byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs so 'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na

bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis mngon du rim gror bya bar 'dod pa dang / bkur stir bya bar 'dod pa dang / phu dud du bya bar 'dod pa dang mchod par bya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /kau shi ka ngas don de nyid kyi dbang yang dag par mthong ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'di snyam ste/ gang zhig la bdag gis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bya ste/ brten cing rnam par spyad par bya snyam na/ kau shi ka de la ngas 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang / myi dang lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang nang dang 'dra ba 'am/ lhag pa yang dag par rjes su ma mthong nas/ de la ngas 'di snyam du bsams te/ de ltar yin na bdag gis chos zhi ba bzang po gang bdag nyid kyis/ mngon par sangs rgyas pa de nyid la/ rim gro dang / bkur bsti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bya ste/ brten cing rnam par spyod par bya'o/ /snyam du bsams so/ /kau shi ka chos de 'di gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yin te/ kau shi ka de ltar nga nyid kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la/ rim gror byed/ bkur stir byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed de/ de ltar rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa byas shing rnam par spyod na/ kau

shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / bya ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba lta ci smos/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba lta ci smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las byung ba ni/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /kau shi ka de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo 'am/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal

mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar de la slob pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag ni/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u nyi shu gnyis so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ gal te 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can de dag dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod par gyur na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de de'i rgyus/ de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel bar 'gyur ram/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam klag pa 'am/ bri ba'am/ kha ton du bya ba'i phyir/ gzhan byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos gang la rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo slob cing / yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur pa dang / 'jug pa dang 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / rgyun

tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa rnams kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur pa dang / 'jug pa dang 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos mang po rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos rgya cher bstan pa de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs

pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dang / 'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos te/ de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las rgya cher bstan to/ /de dag la bslabs shing / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag kyang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka sems can gcig cig rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bzhag na/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel gyi/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pas ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pa'i sems can rnams ni/ sems can

dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas yongs su grol ba ma yin no/ /kau shi ka rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod pa'i sems can ni/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas yongs su grol ba'i phyir te/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod pa lta ci smos/ kau shi ka gang la las 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod pa bas/ la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig rang byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /koo shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun myi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun myi 'chad

pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun mi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun myi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad rang byang chub tu bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can gcig po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu gzhog pa de ni/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun mi gcad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni/ de

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang / mchod cing rim gror bya ba yin te/ 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgus me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod par gyur na/ kau shi ka de ci snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam bri ba 'am/ klag pa 'am/ kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur

ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob po/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub

kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar ba brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa gzhan dag kyang rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas te/ klag pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan byin na/ de ni bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las chos thams cad rgya cher bstan te/ de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yang do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtsho ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed
